reviews.x: Realizing the size of these bottles makes me wonder why not put it all in one large bottle and save on a huge amount of plastic?  Not to mention how hard it is to get the last half of the toothpaste out because the bottles are so small.  Definitely won’t buy again.  Might be organic but it’s not environmentally friendly at all
ITS NOT ORGANIC. SIMPLY  JUST TO LET YOU KNOW  SOME OF THEM NOT EVEN FLUORIDE FREE

I have a 2-yo who likes to eat toothpaste so I'm very careful about what I buy him. I feel good about the ingredients in this fluoride free toothpaste. The only problem is, it tastes so yummy that my little dude will literally stand at the sink sucking on the tube for 5 minutes. LOL. Great price for 4 tubes, and I feel better about these ingredients than other toothpastes available at the store.

We have tried other flavors from Hello and this (apple) is the only flavor my son will use to brush his teeth otherwise we can’t get him to brush.  Granted he usually is sucking the toothpaste off the bristles but I’m able to get his teeth brushed (sorta) in the process.  As long as he asks to brush his teeth, it’s a win in my book.

reviews.t: I just read that this has stevia in it.
reviews.x: My kids asked for watermelon toothpaste, and I was thrilled to find this "natural" product that came in environmentally-friendly packaging. But once I put it on my subscribe and save and got four tubes, I received it and read the ingredients, and it has stevia in it. I don't feel comfortable giving that to my children, and I am very disappointed in this product. Do you have any toothpastes with no stevia? I would happily buy that, but I won't use the four tubes I've received.

My toddler will ONLY use this brand of toothpaste. I love that it’s clear I just wish the bottles were a bit larger. Toddler likes to try and eat the toothpaste straight from the tube so watch out for that.

I have perioral dermatitis and I have a long list of chemicals that I can't use, fluoride is one of them which is included in most toothpaste :( but I recently purchased this toothpaste which doesn't include some of the harmful chemicals I need to stay away from. I can already see my dermatitis getting better. The downside to using this toothpaste is I can see why it's suited for kids, it feels as if I'm brushing my teeth with sugar water, I'm doubtful the toothpaste adds any form of cleansing f

My 8 month old has many food allergies - this is one of the only toothpastes i am comfortable using since there’s no derivatives of corn as far as I could tell! My Little One also had no problem with the flavor.  Good job, Hello!  Highly recommend for a first toothpaste.
I purchased these training toothpastes for my little one but they sent me the expired ones. No tolerance! Waisted my time to receive them. Not happy with this at all.
My baby has never given me a problem. No gum irritation or anything. 5 stars! I do wish I could just buy one. I don't need 4 lol.

I initially got this at Target and my 12 month old and she loved it , to the point that she cries if we delay her tooth brushing routine at night... she is 18 months now and continue enjoy it. I ordered on Amazon because we couldn't find it at target again, and so far is as we expected. Is  a great toothpaste intro for babies, safe for their stomachs since is Fluor free, taste good and makes teeth brushing the best experience for babies.

....and the wife likes that it is fluoride free, so she doesn't worry if they swallow a little bit of it. They have another one we've tried (Sparkle Unicorn or something like that), but as that one has fluoride, she is not as comfortable with it. This one though, both tastes great and makes her happy. Plus, the kids love it, so it makes teeth brushing time easier.  It is much better than the strawberry flavored one also, so go for apple!

reviews.t: Wish watermelon came in toddler training
reviews.x: My 2 yr old loves this. Had the small 4 oz tube for a year and a half (with brushing nearly everyday)and its finally time to replace! She too will sit and suck it out of the tube but its flouride free so I'm not too paranoid. I wish the Toddler Training one came in watermelon too, I'd like to try it once she's over the toothpaste eating thing.

So I haven’t actually tasted this myself but it’s the ONLY toothpaste my 2 year old will put in his mouth. They used to sale this at the department store but no longer carry this exact one so I’m extremely happy to have found it here! I made a huge mistake in attempting any other flavors with him

This was the first toothpaste I've ever tried with my baby boy and I think he loved it, from what I could tell. Up until now we had been brushing with water only so you can only imagine how exciting it was for his to experience something this fresh and sweet when we brushed his teeth together.

Tastes great and does the job. My kid loves all the flavors of toothpaste that Hello has to offer. They all taste like the real fruit. Such a positive thing to get a toddler to brush their teeth. And the tube is small enough that she can put the tooth paste on with out making a mess.

It was her favorite flavor and I went through 9 fl”baby” toothpastes (including foam ones) before I found this one. She didn’t like the Paw Patrol or Sesame Street or any of the character ones. I’ve recently graduated to big girl toothpaste and bubble gum is her fav just so you know.

reviews.t: 4 count package doesn't fit for one baby
reviews.x: The product was good, my baby likes it, but 4 count in one package is too many for one baby. I bought it one and half month ago and my baby is still using 1 out of 4 and the expiration date is coming soon in about 2 month(too short) so we have to discard 3 of them.

reviews.t: Good flavor, good habit, good distraction
reviews.x: Used this starting about 14 months, and we hand him a toothbrush while changing into PJ's.  He happily brushes and grins, instead of protesting being put on his back :)  Clean teeth AND less repetitive singing of the Itsy-Bitsy Spider to distract him.  Win-win.

reviews.t: The only toothpaste my daughter will use
reviews.x: Like many, my toddler hates brushing her teeth.  But she absolutely loves this toothpaste.  We have bought several different types but she will only use this one.  She loves it so much, I have caught her trying to suck it out the tube!

reviews.t: Great product for households with berry allergies.
reviews.x: We chose this product as it is one of the few training toothpastes available that isn’t berry flavored. With a berry allergy in the family we must be careful what products are in our house.  The Apple flavor has been a hit.

The only toothpaste my 6 year old can use. My son is very sensitive to flavors and this is the only toothpaste he doesn't act like is going to make him sick. It doesn't smell strong and has a very mild flavor.

My daughter will only use this particular toothpaste. I’ve tried others and doesn’t like it what so ever! Unfortunately it’s no longer where I shop so stocking up thru Amazon makes a 3 year old very happy!

Have other flavors from other natural brands but this is the nightly choice!! 3-year old can’t get enough!! Only downside is it’s easy to squeeze out too much.. So just don’t have Hulk hands when using!
This is the only toothpaste that my son will let me brush his teeth with and so i really like that this is available. I think the other ones are too sweet for him so this is a good balance.

claims.text: Many parents report their toddlers love the taste and are eager to brush, though some note kids suck the toothpaste straight from the tube.
Reviewers value that it is fluoride-free and made with ingredients they feel comfortable with for young children.
Some reviewers complain about the small bottle size and difficulty squeezing out the toothpaste.
A few reviewers question the product's organic/natural claims or object to ingredients like stevia.
